meta.title: Harness control (MCP and API)
meta.description: Control this DeepSeek Harness from MCP clients and an opt-in HTTP API: list and create sessions, send prompts and read replies, manage workspaces, models, plugins, schedules, goals, terminals and settings. Both surfaces are off until you turn them on in this plugin's page. Create an API key per client: full access, or only the workspaces and chats you choose, read only or read and prompt.
